block-no-content.summary: Prose blocks the library viewer renders as '(no content carried)' while the entry holds words. A heading-only section (summary status `empty`) is not counted: its text is in its subsections. `withheld` says when the publication gate suppressed the verbatim text by design — the remedy then is a summary, which a withheld entry may publish.

could-not-determine.summary: A file the judgement needs exists and would not parse, or a PDF source has no extraction to read. Never a pass — the one family `--check` fails on.

summary-backlog.summary: Prose blocks with no current agent summary, per entry. A count, advisory: the drain is slow on purpose.

title-implausible.summary: A title that is present but not believable: a single short token, a doubled word, no recorded meta.title_source, or not the title the authority order (Dublin Core dc.title → referenced.json identity.title → PDF Info /Title or text heading → slug) gives from the entry's files today. Only titles that passed title-missing are judged here.
